data.documentation:
# Household Activity Review

**Provenance:** commissioned by Doc Albright 2026-07-26 (thread cmrdixxrt0bpg07adhbc47keg) after Horace's first spend read hit 403 on both tables: the logging credential FLEET_ACTIVITY_WRITE is write-only by its own design. Reshaped the same day to READ+UPDATE on Hal's sealed-pen audit argument: if score updates ran under the append-only logging token, that token would lose its "any update is a breach" signature. So each credential keeps ONE behavioural signature — logging token: create-only, never reads, never updates; review token: reads plus the two whitelisted score-field updates. This card supersedes the earlier read-only draft; save only the newest.

## Base facts

Household Activity base `appF7jQD4ZKrDC7e1` (always key on the ID; display name can change). Tables: Sessions `tblUi4nmBKX2u8nFx`, Activity `tblNxNLyC31KDQbRl`, Reports `tblFzWUIPSiIGZPln`. Field IDs live in the Household Activity Logging skill's mapping tables; resolve names from schema; filter select fields by choice ID on read paths. Event time: the Airtable createdTime field ("Created") is authoritative; legacy logger-written Timestamp values are historical only.

## Credential

`FLEET_ACTIVITY_REVIEW` — a dedicated Airtable PAT scoped to data.records:read + data.records:write + schema.bases:read, granted ONLY to the Household Activity base. Injected via RunWithCredentials("Household Activity Review", ...). The token is pasted ONCE, on this skill; reviewer lanes run their own whitelisted scripts under this skill's name, so per-lane scoring skills need no credential slot of their own. Never print, log, echo, or persist the token.

## Read pattern

Plain HTTPS GETs from a small script of your own:
- `GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/appF7jQD4ZKrDC7e1/<tableId>?pageSize=100` with `Authorization: Bearer $FLEET_ACTIVITY_REVIEW`
- Always pass `fields[]` to limit columns; full-record reads are the main performance drag.
- Cursor pagination via `offset`; 5 req/s per base cap; on 429 wait 30 s before ANY retry.
- Whole-chain reads: filter Sessions on Root Session ID, then Activity on the member session IDs.

## Update pattern — the ONLY writes this skill sanctions

- Exactly two fields on Activity rows, per the reviewer designations: Agent Quality `fldLExhD3nr41nir6` (Hal only), Human Quality `fldlKDwCGDAj6fah5` (Clive only), Review Status `fldCtTcdklAcDa9tW` (either).
- Review Status convention: "Reviewed" means at least one reviewer pass has happened; set it if currently Unreviewed; never write Unreviewed; the empty score field shows which side remains.
- Updates go through a reviewer script FIELD-WHITELISTED to those IDs (e.g. Hal's score_update.py). PATs cannot restrict fields, so the whitelist lives in the script — treat any update touching another field as a defect regardless of what the token would allow.
- Event content is immutable. Corrections are new rows via the logging pen. No deletes, ever. Report rows are immutable (revisions supersede).

## Boundaries

- Reviewer lanes only (Hal, Clive Wigglesworth, Horace Farthing — Horace reads only; his commission grants no score fields). Attachment to any other agent is a Matthew decision.
- The logging credential (FLEET_ACTIVITY_WRITE) is never used for reads or updates; the pen stays sealed append-only.
- Never copy log content bodies into other bases or artifacts beyond what the review deliverable needs; never quote secrets that appear inside logged messages.
